# Price drop and back-in-stock alerts for any product page

> Get price drop and back-in-stock alerts for any product page, free. Runs on your own GitHub Actions, alerts your phone, no account or tracking. Test a page in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/price-drop-watcher/)
